avoid_for: Dark-mode or technology products, playful multi-color brands, data-dense UIs, and any context needing cards, filled buttons, or pill chips — the interface has no containers, so standard UI chrome reads as alien on the flat vellum.
best_for: Healing and wellness practices, single-practitioner editorial sites, galleries, and quiet warm-toned brands wanting a reverent gallery-wall atmosphere — one real plant photograph and vast vellum whitespace doing all the emotional work.
name: Leandra-isler
palette_voice: Warm Vellum Sand (#f4e6cd) canvas stretching edge-to-edge with a 4-stop vertical gradient wash (#8f774b → #ba9d6a → #d6bd97 → #f4e6cd) only on the hero; Aged Ink (#1e211e) near-black carries 95% of rules, headings, and body; the living green of a single botanical photograph is the only non-neutral color in the system; Pressed Linen (#edddc3) is the sole secondary surface — no competing UI colors, no shadows.
signature_moves: Extreme display scaling — one typeface stretched from 14px captions to 158–173px weight-500 hero headlines; scale itself is the hierarchy
Underlined text links only — 1px underline offset 2–4px below the baseline, never a filled button, never a pill chip
Edge-to-edge vellum canvas with no max-width container; sections separated by 80–120px of space and occasional 1px hairlines, never cards or panels
A single botanical photograph bleeding past the viewport edges — the 'specimen pressed on paper' metaphor
Warm vertical vellum gradient wash on the hero only — the one place light and shadow exist in the system

source.shadow: none — flat, vellum hero gradient only

tagline: dried botanicals pressed into warm vellum — calm, tactile, editorial, almost reverent.
typographic_voice: One geometric-grotesk sans (PP Neue Montreal, subst. Söhne/Inter) across every element — no serif, no mono, no display face; body stays 16–20px weight 400 with 1.5 line-height while display headlines scale to 122–173px weight 500 with -0.045em tight tracking, giving the same family both whispered body copy and shouted editorial moments without switching personality.
